item.title: Katsina Debunks Campaign Violence Claims, Orders Probe Into Yankara Incident
item.description: The Katsina State Government has dismissed reports linking the incident that occurred in Yankara, Faskari Local Government Area, to Governor Dikko Radda’s Tinubu-Dikko 2027 campaign, describing such claims as false and misleading. In a statement, the government said preliminary findings showed that the disturbance stemmed from a disagreement between participants in a Maulud procession and security personnel over designated procession routes, resulting in confusion along a public street in Yankara. It stressed that the incident was entirely unrelated to thegovernor’s campaign activities or the Tinubu-Dikko campaign rally held in Faskari. According to the government, Governor Radda passed through Yankara without incident on his way to Faskari, where he paid a courtesy visit to the District Head’s Palace and was received by the district head and other traditional rulers. The governor, it said, later proceeded to the Faskari Local Government secretariat, where he inspected ongoing renovation works at the secretariat and council chambers before attending the campaign rally and interacting with residents and supporters. Governor Dikko Radda addresses a crowd of supporters at the Tinubu-Dikko 2027 campaign in Faskari Local Government Area of Katsina State on October 31, 2026. The state government urged relevant security agencies to carry out a thorough investigation to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident and ensure that those responsible are identified where necessary. In the statement signed by the Chief Press Secretary to the Governor, Ibrahim Mohammed, the government appealed to residents to remain calm, uphold peace, and avoid spreading unverified information capable of causing unnecessary tension. Violence was reported in Yankara town on Saturday after suspected hoodlums attacked supporters of the All Progressives Congress (APC), leaving several people injured and a campaign vehicle set ablaze. Eyewitnesses said the attackers allegedly ambushed APC supporters heading to Governor Radda’s campaign rally in Faskari, disrupting movement along the major road and causing panic among residents. Angry youths were also alleged to have blocked the route the campaign convoy was expected to use. item.title: Kane misses penalty as Bayern held by Dortmund
item.description: Fabio Silva’s 89th-minute goal earned Borussia Dortmund a 2-2 draw at Bayern Munich after Harry Kane missed a penalty in a see-saw Bundesliga clash on Saturday. Read Also: How Kane edged Mbappe to Ballon d’Or win Bayern were 1-0 up when Kane, playing his first match since winning the Ballon d’Or on Monday, rattled his second-half spot kick against the crossbar. Dortmund’s Serhou Guirassy levelled things up shortly after, but Kane helped Bayern retake the lead when he set up a Dayot Upamecano goal. But in the final minute, substitutes Konstantinos Karetsas and Silva combined to grab Dortmund a share of the spoils. The result leaves the two ‘Der Klassiker’ sides level on points atop the Bundesliga table, with defending champions Bayern ahead on goal difference. It is just the fourth time in the past 18 matches between these sides that Bayern have not emerged victorious. In addition to the late draw, Bayern, who are without Vincent Kompany as he recovers from a virus, will be concerned by further injuries to their undermanned forward line ahead of Tuesday’s trip to Atletico Madrid. Ismael Saibari, Serge Gnabry and Michael Olise were all subbed out on Saturday, with Jamal Musiala and Luis Diaz already out with injury. Kane was honoured pre-match with his Ballon d’Or shown to the Bayern faithful for the first time. Dortmund thought they had taken the lead with 35 minutes gone as Jobe Bellingham scored from close range, but VAR overturned the goal for offside. Bayern made Dortmund pay immediately when Konrad Laimer pounced on a poor Felix Nmecha pass and charged upfield to score. Bayern were better after the break and a Nmecha handball brought Kane to the spot, but the normally reliable England captain rifled his shot against the crossbar. Moments later, Dortmund captain Nico Schlotterbeck thundered up the pitch and found Chukwuemeka, who laid off for Guirassy to score at the near post. Kane looked to have redeemed himself when he set up a goal for Upamecano soon after, but Silva levelled things up once more in the dying stages. Eren Dinkci also scored for Bremen but the 33-year-old Fuellkrug was the story again. By scoring in his seventh consecutive Bundesliga start, he equalled Rudi Voeller’s club record from 1982-83. “I don’t score these goals to break records,” Fuellkrug said, but added the mark was “nice”. “It’s an absolute joy to play with this group.” He has 12 goals in 10 matches in all competitions for Bremen this season, after scoring just three goals in 18 months at West Ham and one at AC Milan during a six-month loan. item.title: FG deploys experts to Ogun over recurring gas emissions in schools
item.description: By James Ogunnaike The Federal Government has deployed a specialised technical team to Ogun State to investigate recurring subsurface gas emissions that have triggered health concerns and disrupted academic activities in secondary schools across the Ijebu axis. The intervention, coordinated by the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC), is aimed at establishing the geological source of the emissions and recommending lasting solutions to the recurring incidents affecting schools and surrounding communities. The deployment followed reports of localised gas seepages suspected to have caused oxygen depletion and breathing difficulties among students and other residents in the affected communities. Speaking during a joint press briefing and commencement of a site assessment in Ijebu Ode on Saturday, the Federal Government’s Ad-hoc Committee said preliminary indications suggested that the emissions could be associated with natural subsurface geological processes rather than leaks from petroleum pipelines. The team, however, stressed the need for further technical investigations to establish the actual source and nature of the emissions. Speaking at the briefing, the team leader and Assistant Director at the NUPRC, Prosper Okonedo, said the Commission had constituted the committee following an initial assessment conducted by the Ogun State Government. Okonedo explained that the Commission’s Chief Executive, Mrs Oritsemeyawa Eyesan, directed the deployment of experts from its Lagos regional office to collaborate with the state government and investigate the situation. According to him, “about two weeks ago, the Commission Chief Executive of NUPRC, Mrs. Oritsemeyawa Eyesan, advised that we set up an ad-hoc committee from the Lagos regional office to come to the state because the state government had conducted an initial assessment and submitted their report.” He disclosed that the Commission had also been investigating similar incidents in other parts of the country, including communities in Rivers and Delta states. “Presently, we have a study group known as the Epe Study Group. They are looking into similar issues in a village community in Rivers State, and there is one right now in Delta State where we have established that gas seepage is emanating from the subsurface. “However, for this state, we cannot really say what it is right now. That is why we are here, and we are going to deploy to the site to see the situation for ourselves, even though the state government had reported seepages of gas affecting certain secondary schools in some communities,” he said. Okonedo said the federal government was committed to working with the Ogun State government to address the situation and safeguard residents. “The government is there to ensure the welfare and well-being of the Nigerian people. item.title: Troops neutralize suspected bandits in Kogi shootout
item.description: By Kingsley Omonobi Troops of Sector 3, Joint Task Force Operation Whirl Stroke have neutralized a suspected bandit following an intelligence-led ambush along the Adankolo–Apata Road in Kogi State. The operation, conducted on Saturday 31 October 2026, followed credible intelligence on the movement of suspected terrorists around communities in Kabba-Bunu and Lokoja Local Government Areas of the state. Spokesman of the Sector, Captain Ahmad Zubairu who made this known, said the troops acting on the intelligence, troops laid ambush at suspected bandits’ supply route. “The troops subsequently made contact with the suspected criminals who were subdued and forced to flee. “At about 9pm on the same day during exploitation, troops received information regarding the discovery of suspected bandits’ bodies towards Adankolo Forest. “On arrival at the location, troops found corpses of the two suspected bandits and recovered one locally made pistol, one cartridge and one empty case of 7.62mm special ammunition. “The Force Commander, Joint Task Force Operation Whirl Stroke and General Officer Commanding 5 Division, Nigerian Army, Major General Moses Gara, commended the troops for their gallantry and successful execution of the operation. “He urged members of the public to continue supporting security agencies by providing timely and credible information on suspicious activities, stressing that security remains everybody’s responsibility. “The Force Commander reiterated the commitment of Operation Whirl Stroke to sustaining intelligence-led operations aimed at protecting lives and property across its Area of Responsibility.” The post Troops neutralize suspected bandits in Kogi shootout appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Iran says US tone has ‘changed’ as Washington seeks negotiations
item.description: Iran on Saturday said the tone of the United States had “completely changed” as Washington seeks to restart negotiations with the Islamic republic. While the US and Israel have upped their threats to order fresh strikes, Vice President JD Vance also sent a letter to Iranian officials in recent days in a bid to revive talks. “I read the letter. I haven’t yet responded. Their tone has completely changed,” Mohsen Rezaei, the head of Iran’s supreme national security council, said in a video broadcast on Iranian television. He said the change in tone was “a good sign” and showed Iran had “consolidated its victory”. Rezaei said he had not responded to the letter and would not comment further on its contents. His comments came as indirect mediation via Qatar continued, though Iranian officials said earlier on Saturday that they had no plans to meet with US officials. item.title: 2027: Miyetti Allah backs Tinubu’s re-election, cites livestock ministry
item.description: By Ibrahim Hassan-Wuyo The National President of the Miyetti Allah Cattle Breeders Association of Nigeria (MACBAN), Baba Othman Ngelzarma, has declared support for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election bid in 2027, citing the establishment of the Federal Ministry of Livestock Development as a major step towards addressing decades of neglect of the livestock sector. Ngelzarma said pastoralists, cattle breeders and other livestock stakeholders across the country were prepared to support Tinubu for a second term in appreciation of his administration’s recognition of the economic importance of the sector. He spoke at a rally organised in Kaduna by the Fulbe APC Forum and Tinubu Yeso-Yeso Political Forum (TYPF), in collaboration with the Coalition of Pastoralists and Traders Associations and the Amalgamated Union of Livestock Dealers, Butchers and other stakeholders. The rally, held under the theme, “United for Inclusion, Representation and Prosperity,” attracted Fulani organisations, pastoralists, cattle breeders, livestock dealers, butchers, processors and political stakeholders from different parts of the country. Ngelzarma said the creation of the livestock ministry in July 2024 had fulfilled a longstanding demand by pastoralists and livestock operators, who had campaigned for a dedicated government institution to address challenges in the industry for several decades. “We are here today to extend our appreciation and support to the administration of President Tinubu. “The creation of the livestock ministry is something we have been advocating for and looking forward to for decades,” he said. He noted that the initiative had also encouraged some state governments to establish similar institutions to coordinate livestock development, describing it as an opportunity to address longstanding challenges confronting pastoralists and other operators in the industry. The Minister of Livestock Development, Idi Mukhtar Maiha, urged pastoralists, livestock farmers and other stakeholders to take advantage of the ministry’s programmes to improve productivity, expand their businesses and enhance their livelihoods. Maiha identified inadequate veterinary services, limited access to pasture and water, high feed costs, poor market infrastructure and low productivity as some of the factors that had hindered the growth of Nigeria’s livestock industry over the years. He said Nigeria had an estimated 58 million cattle, 124 million goats, 70 million sheep, 9.3 million pigs, 3.2 million donkeys, 700,000 camels and 300 million birds, describing the figures as enormous economic opportunities that could be harnessed through deliberate investments and improved management. The minister disclosed that seven veterinary hospitals had been completed and equipped under a World Bank-supported programme, while additional facilities were at various stages of completion. item.title: Gov. Lawal presents staff of office, vehicles to 19 Zamfara emirs
item.description: Governor Dauda Lawal has presented staff of office and official vehicles to 19 emirs in Zamfara State. The coronation and presentation ceremony took place at the Trade Fair Complex in Gusau, the state capital. Dignitaries in attendance included His Eminence the Sultan of Sokoto, the Etsu Nupe, and the Emir of Gwandu. After their oaths of office, Governor Lawal presented staff of office to 11 first-class emirs and eight second-class emirs. Each newly coronated emir also received a GAC Ultra SUV (2025/2026 model), a Mikano ZNA Hilux vehicle and an EV Antique Model car (DDP). The vehicles are intended to support their travels and help them engage more closely with their communities. In his remarks, Governor Lawal said the ceremony reflected his administration’s recognition of the traditional institution as an enduring part of society and an important partner in promoting peace, stability and development. He noted that the ceremony also reaffirmed his administration’s commitment to giving traditional rulers the recognition and institutional support they need to carry out their responsibilities effectively. He said, “The staff of office being presented today signifies the authority entrusted to you by the State. “It also represents a responsibility to govern your respective domains with fairness, wisdom, integrity, and compassion. “I expect every emir to carry out their responsibilities without discrimination, uphold justice, and ensure that the traditional institution remains accessible to all members of the community. “Our people must find guidance, fairness, and reassurance in their traditional rulers. “Recognising the importance of royal palaces as centres of traditional authority and community engagement, I reaffirm our commitment to completing the reconstruction and rehabilitation of the remaining royal palaces. “This is part of our broader effort to strengthen these institutions and improve the conditions in which traditional rulers carry out their responsibilities. “We are also providing official vehicles to the 19 emirs. These include GAC ULTRA SUVs (2025/2026 models), MIKANO ZNA HILUX vehicles, and EV ANTIQUE MODEL cars (DDP). “This provision is intended to facilitate travel across your respective emirates, encourage closer engagement with your communities, and improve coordination with government institutions. “I expect these vehicles to be properly maintained and used responsibly in support of your official duties.” The governor also urged the royal fathers to build a productive partnership between their emirates and the state government. Earlier, the Sultan of Sokoto, Alhaji Sa’ad Abubakar, urged the newly coronated emirs to remain fully loyal to the authority. He also encouraged them to respect and uphold the dignity of the traditional institution as they discharge their duties. The post Gov. Lawal presents staff of office, vehicles to 19 Zamfara emirs appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Sowore reacts as Ekiti police arrest 11 over attack
item.description: By Ayobami Okerinde The Ekiti State Police Command has arrested 11 suspects over the attack on African Action Congress (AAC) presidential aspirant, Omoyele Sowore, and members of his team at a restaurant in Ado-Ekiti, the state capital. In a statement on Saturday, the command’s Public Relations Officer, Abutu Sunday, said operatives of the Rapid Response Squad arrested the suspects at their hideouts in the Atikankan area of the town at about 10pm on Friday, following a tip-off. It partly reads, “The Ekiti State Police Command has arrested eleven (11) suspects in connection with the alleged attack on Mr Omoyele Sowore, an African Action Congress (AAC) presidential aspirant, and other persons at Tawakalitu Restaurant, Dalimore Area of Ado-Ekiti. “The suspects are Joseph Tayo ’32yrs’, Olatunji Abayomi ’41yrs’, Isaac Amba ’22yrs’, Kehinde Ajigbana ’18yrs’, Tosin David ’18yrs’, Solomon Iyanu ’18yrs’, Ogunsola Ayomide ’21yrs’, Ojo Ayodeji ’22yrs’, Kayode Dada ’32yrs’, Segun Olatunji ’28yrs’ and Salami Emmanuel ’53yrs’. “Items recovered include two walkie-talkies, substances suspected to be Indian hemp and Colorado, two Indian hemp crushers, one pack of Rizla, seven ATM cards, thirteen mobile phones, two vehicle keys, one flash drive, one 5G MTN Wi-Fi device, identity cards, eight international passports, three complimentary cards, two suspected criminal charms, one gas lighter and ₦250.” The police said investigations were ongoing to establish the individual roles of the suspects and determine their possible connections with the attack. The Commissioner of Police, Falade Michael, assured residents that everyone found culpable would be brought to justice. The statement quoted him as saying that the command “will leave no stone unturned in ensuring that all those found culpable are brought to justice.” Reacting to the arrests, Sowore demanded that the alleged masterminds and sponsors of the attack be identified and brought to justice, insisting that the incident was a coordinated assault and not an ordinary altercation. The presidential candidate made the demand in a post on X on Saturday, describing the arrests as an admission that the incident was a violent attack. He also alleged that some of the attackers were associated with the City Boys group and called for investigations into possible links between the incident and officials of the state government. Sowore urged the Commissioner of Police, Falade Adegoroye Michael, and the Department of State Services to preserve and release CCTV footage from the scene to help identify those involved. “Arresting 11 suspects is not enough if those who planned, financed, coordinated and facilitated the attack remain untouched,” he wrote. He also demanded an explanation from the police over their initial description of the incident as an altercation. item.title: 2027: ‘Don’t be deceived, vote for Tinubu’ – South-East govs tell Igbo
item.description: Governors of Anambra, Ebonyi, Enugu and Imo States have urged the people not to be deceived by political distractions but to vote massively for President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 presidential election. The governors made the call on Saturday during the All Progressives Congress (APC) Women Mega Rally and Empowerment Programme for the South-East, held at Okpara Square, Enugu. The governors are Prof. Charles Soludo of Anambra, Francis Nwifuru of Ebonyi, Dr Peter Mbah of Enugu and Sen. Hope Uzodimma of Imo. Speaking, Mbah urged the people of the South-East to support Tinubu’s re-election bid to enable him to consolidate the gains of his administration’s economic reforms. He attributed ongoing development projects, including the construction of primary healthcare centres, to the Federal Government’s economic reforms. The governor urged women to support Tinubu and APC candidates in the Jan. 16, 2027, and subsequent elections. “A good sailor does not abandon his ship mid-sea because of challenges. We must finish the journey we all started together,” he said. Mbah described South Easterners as strategic people who had established businesses and relationships beyond the zone, urging them to participate actively in the political process. Speaking on the empowerment programme targeting 5,000 women across the South-East, Mbah said the initiative followed the empowerment of more than 2,000 women in Enugu within 48 hours. He said the beneficiaries received cash support, assistance with hospital bills and tools to enable them to generate income. According to him, the programme is designed to make women wealth creators rather than perpetual beneficiaries of financial assistance. “When you empower a woman, you strengthen the family. When you empower a woman, you build a strong community,” he said. He urged the beneficiaries to make effective use of the empowerment tools and extend the benefits to their families and communities. Uzodimma Also speaking, Uzodimma described the rally as historic and commended the First Lady, Sen. Oluremi Tinubu, for empowering women across the South-East. He reiterated the commitment of the region to supporting Tinubu’s re-election in 2027. He explained that Igbos had experienced marginalisation for over 60 years but were beginning to witness a new era of political inclusion and development under Tinubu. He commended the president for expanding the scope of infrastructural and economic development in the South-East. “We are now seeing good roads, electricity, health reforms as well as educational reforms in the country. A winning team must not be changed,” he said. The governor urged the electorate to sustain the current development trajectory, saying the Federal Government’s economic reforms had increased resources available to states for development. “We have more money to build Okigwe to Owerri, Umuahia to Owerri, Orlu to Owerri and Owerri to Port Harcourt roads,” he said. item.title: Police repel bandits’ attack on Kebbi community
item.description: By Haruna Aliyu, Birnin Kebbi The Kebbi State Police Command has said that it is aware of the security incident in Ribah, Zuru Local Government Area, on 30th October 2026, when suspected bandits launched two successive attacks on the community. Police image maker, in a statement on Saturday, revealed that the first incident occurred at about 7:25 pm, when the assailants attempted to block Rambo Junction along the Ribah–Dirin Daji Road under Zuru emirate, as their attempt was promptly foiled by the joint security forces comprising the police, military and local vigilante group, who engaged them in a gun duel and dispersed them. The statement added that the attackers later regrouped and returned, shooting sporadically from different directions within the town. However, during the ensuing exchange, one Hassan Boder, aged 47, a security guard at a newly constructed filling station along Ribah–Kanya Road, was fatally hit by a bullet. Upon receipt of a distress call, the joint security team swiftly mobilised, engaged the attackers and successfully repelled them. Usman explained that security operations have since been intensified, with aggressive patrols ongoing to dominate the area and efforts underway to track down and apprehend the perpetrators. “Yes, we are aware of the attack and we have repelled it by forcing the terrorists to retreat due to superior firepower. The combined security forces have dominated the area to prevent further attacks on the communities,” he said. item.title: Clashes break out as hundreds of thousands protest in France
item.description: Police fired tear gas and clashed with protesters in Paris and elsewhere on Saturday as hundreds of thousands marched across France against soaring living costs and police violence, with some demonstrators dressed as clowns and witches for Halloween. While the third consecutive weekend of nationwide protests was largely peaceful, tensions erupted in several cities later Saturday. After a march on the outskirts of Paris in bright sunshine, clashes broke out between police and some demonstrators as the procession reached its final destination. Dozens of masked people dressed in black used hammers to pry up paving stones and hurl them at police. At least one incendiary device was also thrown at security forces. Police responded with tear gas and several baton charges. “A hard core of several hundred rioters” at the rear of the march attacked police with projectiles, including a Molotov cocktail, the police prefecture said. Officers were seeking “to restore public order”, it added. In Lyon, France’s third-largest city, people threw projectiles at police, prompting officers to fire tear gas, according to a journalist at the scene. In the southern city of Toulouse, police used water cannon against an unauthorised protest that drew several thousand people, mostly young demonstrators. – ‘Dressed up as angry citizen’ – Earlier Saturday, thousands of people, some wearing costumes ranging from Spider-Man to Frankenstein, walked through eastern Paris as a helicopter circled overhead. Placards read: “No need for tear gas to make our future look bleak” and “Dressed up as an angry citizen for Halloween.” A protester wearing a Marie-Antoinette costume (L) holds a placard reading “Give them brioche” flanked by a protester dressed as a wizard holding a placard reading “A potion for the revolution” during a demonstration in Lyon, central-eastern France on October 31, 2026, part of nationwide demonstrations over the rising cost of living and inequality organised by Yellow Vest movement, labour unions and high school and university students. “Exceptional” security deployment with 70,000 police officers and gendarmes mobilized and an alarmist tone: for Act III of the protests against the high cost of living, right in the middle of Halloween festivities, the authorities fear a repeat of the October 17 nightmare. France has been rocked by widespread anger over the rising cost of living and inequality. (Photo by JEFF PACHOUD / AFP) “We say no to the cost of living, no to the far right, yes to high school students’ demands, yes to giving citizens a voice,” said Camille Guerin, 31, a demonstrator in the western city of Nantes. Authorities said that some 320,000 people rallied across France including 70,000 in Paris. According to youth organisations, nearly half a million people demonstrated across the country, including 200,000 in Paris. item.title: US yet to decide on new Iran strikes, says Rubio
item.description: US President Donald Trump has not made a decision about fresh strikes on Iran amid stalled peace talks, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Saturday. “We can achieve military objectives if we seek to,” Rubio told a press conference in Atlanta, Georgia, where he was hosting G20 foreign ministers for a two-day meeting. But Rubio added that Trump “hasn’t made a decision” on further military action, amid reports that the US leader could attack after key midterm elections on Tuesday. “I have no announcement in that regard with you today, and nor do we take any of it lightly,” Rubio said. While he slammed Tehran for “actively and openly” targeting commercial vessels for attack, Rubio also expressed Trump’s preference for a diplomatic solution to end war with Iran. But he did not commit to a timeline for talks. “I’m not going to characterize neither the progress on those talks nor any timeframe on it, other than to tell you that if there is a diplomatic solution, we would be open to it,” Rubio said. Iran’s supreme leader on Saturday warned the United States and Israel against launching new attacks, following threats to resume strikes after crucial elections. Trump earlier warned of the potential for fresh military action after US midterms, saying previously that he was weighing up whether to “finish them off.” But any further attack would spark concern among US allies. On Thursday, EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas told AFP: “We are calling for a diplomatic solution, and really, escalation does not benefit anyone.” AFP The post US yet to decide on new Iran strikes, says Rubio appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Africa’s First Ever Youth Olympics Open In Senegal
item.description: The 2026 Youth Olympic Games, the first Olympics ever to be held on African soil, opened Saturday in the Senegalese capital, marking an historic moment for the continent. Signs proclaiming “Africa welcomes, Dakar celebrates” are omnipresent across Dakar, which is hosting nearly 2,700 young competitors aged 14 to 17 from around the world. The event will see the return of Russian athletes to the Olympics and also includes a refugee team. Overall, the young athletes will compete across 25 sports and 153 medal events. “Today it’s not just a nation that is welcoming the Youth Olympic Games; it’s an entire continent that is opening its arms”, Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye told a sport and development summit Saturday ahead of the Games’ opening ceremony. Senegal’s Influencer and TikToker Khaby Lame carries the Youth Olympic Flame on the eve of the opening ceremony of the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar on October 30, 2026. Photo by PATRICK MEINHARDT / AFP The Games will not only celebrate champions but also “our collective capacity to transform sport into an economic and social engine”, he said, emphasising that 130 years of Olympic history had passed before the Olympic flame ever landed on African soil. Events ranging from athletics to beach wrestling, rugby sevens to breaking, will be held across eight venues in three locations. Dakar, the nearby suburb of Diamniadio and the beach town of Saly, located some 80 kilometres (50 miles) from the capital, will all host events. The Games are “showing the world our capacity (as Africa), a capacity that sometimes is underestimated”, International Olympic Committee (IOC) President Kirsty Coventry, a former Zimbabwean swimmer, said Saturday during the summit. According to Coventry, the opening ceremony will be televised live in more than 30 countries, with every African nation having committed to showing the Games live, she said. Sports Culture An opening ceremony Saturday evening in Diamniadio will kick off the Games. A total of 136 Senegalese athletes will participate in the Youth Olympics, with some 6,000 volunteers from Senegal helping put on the event. The West African nation is renowned for its sports culture, including its football team, traditional wrestling and surf scene. Football enthusiasts and young people often organise impromptu matches in the evenings or on weekends on the beach or in village squares. And as the day cools, hundreds of people flock to Dakar’s iconic coastal road, the Corniche, to run, do strength training or take part in group exercise. While a sense of excitement is beginning to stir in the capital, the fourth summer edition of the Youth Olympics has struggled to stoke wild enthusiasm across Senegal. item.title: 2027: Kano NDC governorship candidate still missing in INEC’s updated list
item.description: By Hadiza Yusuf The governorship candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, NDC, in Kano State, Aminu Abdussalam Gwarzo, and his running mate, Mustapha Rabiu Kwankwaso, are still missing from the updated final list of candidates released by the Independent National Electoral Commission, INEC. The updated list released on Saturday, retained the omission of the NDC candidates. The commission, however, included candidates from several political parties, including the All Progressives Congress (APC), Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), African Democratic Congress (ADC), Labour Party (LP), Action Alliance (AA), African Action Congress (AAC), Action Democratic Party (ADP), Allied Peoples Movement (APM), New Nigeria Peoples Party (NNPP) and Peoples Redemption Party (PRP), among others. Among those listed are Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf and Murtala Sule Garo of the APC, Abacha Muhammad Sani and Kibiya Yusuf Ado of the PDP, and Ibrahim Ali Amin and Shehu Abdulkadir Bari of the ADC. Recall that the NDC had blamed an error for the omission of its candidate and his running mate from the list of candidates published by the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) in the initial release. Dr Yusuf Ibrahim Kofarmata, Secretary of the Kwankwasiyya Caucus and the NDC House of Representatives candidate in Kano in a statement, at the time, said the party had received assurances that the omission resulted from an error in entering the candidates’ details. Earlier ommission Initially, INEC released the list of candidates for various positions two weeks ago. But the names of the NDC governorship candidate and his running mate were missing from the Kano State section. Dr Yusuf Ibrahim Kofarmata, Secretary of the Kwankwasiyya Caucus and the NDC House of Representatives candidate in Kano, in a statement, said the party had received assurances that the omission resulted from an error in entering the candidates’ details. He said INEC was working to correct the problem, and expressed confidence that the names would be included. Kofarmata said Gwarzo completed his registration within the period set by INEC. He added that the party submitted the candidate’s details through the commission’s online portal. Kofarmata urged party supporters to remain calm and continue their activities despite the development. However, Aminu Abdussalam Gwarzo, and his running mate, Mustapha Rabiu Kwankwaso, are still missing from the updated final list of candidates. item.title: 2027: Makinde most competent presidential candidate – Daura
item.description: Vice-presidential candidate of the Allied People’s Movement (APM), Alhaji Lawal Daura, has declared Gov. Seyi Makinde of Oyo State as the most competent and credible presidential candidate for the 2027 general elections. Daura ​‌‍‍‍‍⁠⁠‍‌‍‍‌​‍‌⁠‌​made this declaration while receiving leaders of the Northern Patriotic Front (NPF) at the party’s presidential campaign headquarters in Abuja on Saturday. The vice-presidential candidate said Makinde stood head and shoulders above his political rivals based on his proven track record, performance in public office and unmatched vision for national development. He reassured citizens across the country, particularly within the Northern region, that a Makinde-Daura administration would function as a four-year all-inclusive transitional government of national unity. Daura explained that this interim framework was specifically designed to radically overhaul and reset Nigeria’s economy, education system, security architecture and socio-political environment. While urging the electorate to look past ethnic and religious biases, he said that public office seekers must face rigorous scrutiny regarding their personal antecedents and stewardship. He challenged sceptics to look closely at Makinde’s credentials, stressing that he built a solid reputation as a successful businessman with extensive finance experience before transitioning into politics. According to him, true national progress relies entirely on holding leaders accountable on how they manage public trust and resources. “I was happy when you said that you went to Oyo State and you have confirmed the quality of governance and unprecedented development by our presidential candidate. “So, I throw a challenge that anyone who is still doubting whether our candidate is the most competent to be elected as president to examine his antecedents and performance,” he stated. Daura further emphasised the critical need for a complete departure from past governance failures, arguing that Nigeria could no longer afford to tolerate empty leadership. “Before venturing into politics and eventually becoming governor of Oyo State, he had established himself as a successful businessman and a man with considerable experience in finance. “Beyond his personal integrity, we should also examine his record in public office. What has he achieved? Look at his performance; his transparency and accountability set him apart,” Daura added. The NPF President, Alhaji Ali Abacha, formally pledged the undivided support of northern political stakeholders for the APM ticket. Abacha noted that the northern region deeply resonated with Makinde’s ‘Reset Nigeria’ message and supported the vision of a four-year transitional administration. He praised the inclusion of Daura, whom he described as a respected security expert, as the vice-presidential nominee, stating that the pairing had brought immense confidence to the nation regarding the urgent task of tackling widespread insecurity. item.title: Deliver your ward or… – Gombe APC gov candidate tells supporters
item.description: By John Alechenu, ABUJA The All Progressives Congress, APC, governorship candidate in Gombe State, Dr. Jamil Gwamna, has challenged party members and supporters to prove their political worth at the grassroots. Gwamna launched what he described as ‘Operation Deliver Your Ward’, calling on supporters to secure victory for the party from their polling units and wards. He spoke during activities marking Gombe State’s 30th anniversary celebration. According to him, the true measure of political strength and influence lies not in rhetoric, but in the ability to mobilise grassroots support, beginning from one’s polling unit. He said he would hold in the highest regard those political associates who demonstrate commitment by winning their polling units and delivering their wards. Gwamna said, “The true test is at the polling unit. We will hold in highest regard those who deliver their wards. We will continue to reach every nook and cranny of Gombe State to seek support and votes.” The APC candidate called on party members to put aside their differences, close ranks and work together as a united force, likening the strength of the party to the strands of a broom bound together. He urged voluntary organisations, support groups, youths, women and other APC stakeholders to step up grassroots engagement, strengthen party structures and mobilise support for victory at all levels. Gwamna also reaffirmed his commitment to providing purposeful and responsible leadership, assuring the people of Gombe State that if entrusted with the mandate, he would govern with justice, honesty and accountability. item.title: Imo postpones LG election indefinitely
item.description: By Emmanuel Iheaka OWERRI – The local government election in Imo State scheduled for November 7, 2026, has been postponed indefinitely. The Chairman of the Imo State Independent Electoral Commission, ISIEC, Chief Charles Ejiogu, announced this during a stakeholders meeting in Owerri on Saturday. Ejiogu, though declined to offer any specific reason for the postponement, said the commission was “constrained to announce that the election will not hold.” The chairman stated that the commission will set a new date for the poll within the shortest possible time. Recall that the election was initially fixed for September 26, but the state government said it couldn’t hold due to litigations. “At this juncture, having consulted widely, the Imo State Independent Electoral Commission is constrained to announce that the scheduled Saturday 7th November, 2026 Local Government Council Elections will no longer hold. “Today, the commission will afford you the opportunity to express your considered view points with informed suggestions, as it works towards the new date. “Rest assured that within the shortest possible time, the commission will announce the new date, time table and guidelines. “On behalf of the Imo state Independent Electoral Commission, ISIEC, I hasten to doubly assure all of you that at no time will the commission shirk its constitutional responsibility of conducting a peaceful, transparent and credible Local Government Councils election that will usher in a democratically elected Council Chairmen and Councilors and there will be no two ways to it, as it is a task that must be accomplished,” Ejiogu said. The chairman assured of level playing ground for all the political parties and called for tolerance. “Let me reassure the political parties and their aspirants/candidates that as an Electoral Management Body that the ISIEC will present to all of you a seamless level playing ground for all your Chairmanship and Councillorship candidates that will emerge after the primaries. “In collaboration with the security agencies, the commission is working towards the setting up of Inter Agency Consultative Committee on Election Security, ICCES, that will comprise the Nigeria Police, Nigeria Army, Navy, Air-force DSS, NSCDC and other sister agencies to ensure adequate security before, during and after the elections. We urge IPAC to sign and uphold a PEACE ACCORD, as no one or group of persons will be allowed to subvert the will of the people in the upcoming Council elections,” he submitted. Ejiogu said the meeting was to listen to the stakeholders and seek their empathy and understanding, maintaining that such will collectively build the necessary safeguards for a peaceful, transparent and credible council elections. item.title: Carrick expects to stay as Man Utd coach despite Chelsea defeat
item.description: Michael Carrick said he expects to remain in charge of Manchester United for Tuesday’s Champions League visit of Roma despite a 2-0 defeat at Chelsea that stretched the club’s winless run to nine matches. Carrick was given a stay of execution by the United hierarchy after a 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth last weekend when many expected the axe to fall on the former England midfielder. United were much improved during the first half at Stamford Bridge but paid for a lack of ruthlessness as the visitors wasted a number of chances to take the lead. Morgan Rogers strolled through the heart of the United defence to open the scoring early in the second half. Lisandro Martinez was then shown two quick yellow cards and conceded a penalty, converted by Cole Palmer, to kill off any hope of a United fightback. “Yes,” Carrick told TNT Sports when asked if he expected to remain in charge for the Roma match. “We’ve got to move forward. We’ve got to take the things that we felt worked for us today and take a bit of belief and the confidence from that and a lot of the good things, especially in the first half.” United’s longest winless run for 38 years leaves them just one point above the Premier League relegation zone and at risk of dropping into the bottom three by the end of the weekend. “From being in such a good place in the first half, the two halves of football couldn’t probably be more further apart in some ways,” added Carrick. “I think the way they went about it and played, the quality of football and the way we played in the first half, definitely gives encouragement. We’ve got to take that.” Two defeats in their first three Champions League games have left United 20th in the 36-team table and at risk of missing out on the knockout stages. item.title: Atletico Beat Levante, Move Top Above Barcelona
item.description: Atletico Madrid earned a solid 2-0 win at Levante on Saturday to move provisionally to the top of La Liga before Barcelona host Alaves later on. Diego Simeone’s side climbed a point clear of the Catalan giants, who suffered their first league defeat against rivals Real Madrid last weekend. Goals from Alejandro Grimaldo and Giuliano Simeone in Valencia helped Atletico record a seventh consecutive league win to continue their strong form and put pressure on the reigning champions. “I’m very happy with the team’s work,” Atletico coach Simeone told Movistar. “We’re very far from the end of the season… we’ll keep going game by game.” There was a minute’s silence at the start of the match in memory of the 69 victims of the train crash in the province of Toledo that rocked Spain this week. Levante’s Dani Requena forced Atletico goalkeeper Jan Oblak into an impressive early save. Morten Hjulmand thought he had put Atletico ahead after Alex Baena slipped him in, but a VAR review showed the Dane was offside. Atletico Madrid’s Argentine coach Diego Simeone (centre) reacts during the Spanish league football match between Levante UD and Club Atletico de Madrid at Ciutat de Valencia Stadium in Valencia on October 31, 2026. (Photo by JOSE JORDAN / AFP) Baena, the visitors’ main creative outlet, was involved in the opener. The Spaniard’s pass was poorly defended by Levante and the ball bobbled through to Grimaldo, who lashed high into the net at the near post. Lee Kang-in hit the crossbar early in the second half as Atletico looked to put the game to bed. The coach’s son Giuliano prodded home for Atletico’s second goal after being played in by World Cup winner Baena. Oblak saved superbly from Karl Etta Eyong to stop the hosts fighting their way back into the game. It was Simeone’s 344th La Liga win at the helm of Atletico, matching the club’s record set by Luis Aragonés. “I don’t feel it much as mine, but it belongs to my players, everyone who has been with me for so many years,” said Simeone, who started coaching Atletico in 2011. Atletico host Bayern Munich in the Champions League on Tuesday before welcoming Barca to the Metropolitano stadium next weekend in La Liga. On Sunday, Jose Mourinho’s Real Madrid, third, visit Racing Santander among other fixtures. AFP The post Atletico Beat Levante, Move Top Above Barcelona appeared first on Channels Television .

item.title: Zamfara Gov Presents Staff Of Office, Vehicles To 19 Emirs
item.description: Governor Dauda Lawal of Zamfara State has presented staff of office and official vehicles to the 19 emirs in the state as part of efforts to strengthen traditional institutions and enhance grassroots administration. The ceremony, held in Gusau, the state capital, formed part of activities marking the 30th anniversary of Zamfara State. The presentation brought together all 19 emirs, including some who had been appointed before the current administration but were not formally coronated until Governor Lawal assumed office. While addressing the monarchs, the Sultan of Sokoto, Alhaji Muhammad Sa’ad Abubakar III, urged them to always uphold the fear of God in the discharge of their duties. Speaking at the ceremony, Governor Dauda Lawal (right) described the presentation as a significant milestone in the history and governance of the state. He emphasised that traditional rulers must speak the truth without fear or favour, stressing that their loyalty should be to God Almighty. The Sultan also expressed concern over the poor condition of the Sokoto-Gusau Road and called on the relevant authorities to take urgent action to address the situation. Speaking at the ceremony, Lawal described the presentation as a significant milestone in the history and governance of the state. He reaffirmed his administration’s recognition of traditional rulers as critical partners in promoting peace, stability and development. The governor noted that since Zamfara State was created in 1996, traditional institutions had continued to play vital roles in maintaining social order, preserving cultural values and fostering harmonious relationships among communities. He urged the emirs to discharge their responsibilities with fairness, wisdom, integrity and compassion. Governor Lawal particularly called on the traditional rulers to strengthen collaboration with security agencies by providing credible information, mobilising community support and discouraging the protection or concealment of criminal elements, irrespective of their identities or affiliations. He stressed that restoring lasting peace required sustained government efforts, effective security operations and the cooperation and confidence of local communities. The governor also reaffirmed his administration’s commitment to completing the reconstruction and rehabilitation of the remaining royal palaces across the state, noting that the initiative was aimed at strengthening traditional institutions and improving the working environment of traditional rulers. As part of the support, the state government distributed official vehicles to all 19 emirs to facilitate their movement, enhance community engagement, and improve coordination with government institutions. He urged the traditional rulers to ensure proper maintenance and responsible use of the vehicles strictly for official assignments.
